title: eyes like yours
lyrics_plain:
Oh, you know I have seen

A sky without sun
A man with no nation
Saints captive in chains
A song with no name
For lack of imagination
Ya he ya he ya la he

And I have seen
Darker than ebony
Ya he ya he ya la he
And now it seems that I
Without your eyes

My one desire

Forever to live

There's nothing

Came from Bahrain
Got to Beirut
Looking for someone

Comparing to you
Tearing down
Windows and doors
And I could not
Find eyes like yours
